title: Semantic Kit Command Events
description: compose/rs: enforce external kit modification exclusively through semantic commands. Commands are async and return only request ids; success/result/error is delivered over events. Ensure compose/js stores track requests and emit correct events consumed by compose/react. Extend existing tests only and verify relevant Rust/JS/React checks pass.
summary: Routed compose/js fallback and worker mutation helpers through GraphQL semantic mutations, added client-scoped kit command request ids with accepted/succeeded/failed lifecycle events, exposed lifecycle type guards, and wired compose/react KitScope to record those events and related errors for hooks. Added the missing JS in-memory store glue exports used by React and extended existing embedded JS/React tests for request tracking and lifecycle consumption. Verified JS tests, React tests/build, and Rust cargo tests.
